🇮🇳🤝🇦🇷 Rotary Friendship Exchange 2026 27.
Rotary Official Meeting at San Isidro Club

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown | District 3141, India
RFE Argentina 2026–27 | District 4895

As part of the Rotary Friendship Exchange with Argentina, the delegation of Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown, District 3141, attended a wonderful Rotary meeting at San Isidro Club, Buenos Aires.

The meeting provided an excellent platform for Rotarians from District 3141 and District 4895 to come together, exchange ideas and strengthen international friendships. An engaging discussion on Rotary projects and community initiatives gave both sides an opportunity to learn from each other and explore possibilities for collaboration.

A special highlight of the evening was the Flag Exchange Ceremony, symbolising the friendship and goodwill between the two Rotary districts and our two countries.

The formal meeting was followed by a warm fellowship Lunch, where Rotarians continued their conversations, shared experiences and created new friendships.

It was a well-conducted and memorable Rotary meeting, beautifully reflecting the true spirit of the Rotary Friendship Exchange—Service, Fellowship, International Understanding and lasting friendship beyond borders.

Two Districts • Two Countries • One Rotary Family
